Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily's mom gave her a big hug to make her feel better. 

Lily went to her mom and said, "Mom, can I have a big hug?" Her mom said, "Of course, Lily. Let's go for a walk and see if we can see the world." 

Lily and her mom explored the world together. They ran and jumped, until it was time to go home. When it was dark, Lily's mom came out and said, "That's amazing! Now it's time for bed."
